title: Option to hide file extensions in Folder View in all displayed locations, not just desktop:/
line: Folder View now shows .desktop files by their name, without the .desktop extension, in any local folder, not just the Desktop folder.
explanation: Folder View only showed .desktop files by their Name when it displayed desktop:/, because the desktop:/ KIO worker sets the display name; for any other folder the model used the plain file name, so launchers showed up as "foo.desktop". The model now reads the Name of local .desktop files itself (cached, refreshed when the file changes) and uses it for the label, sorting and renaming, and the QML enables desktop-file handling for every local folder. Renaming such an item writes the new Name into the file instead of renaming it, as the desktop:/ worker does.

commits.message:
containments/desktop: show desktop file names in any local folder

Only desktop:/ showed .desktop files by their Name, so a Folder View
set to any other folder listed them as "foo.desktop". Do the same for
local folders: show, sort and rename them by Name, like on the desktop.

BUG: 448884
